response.text: {"issues":["Homepage has no visible banned-pattern violations: the hero headline is specific, there are no numbered labels, emoji, filler phrases or three-icon card row, and only the left-aligned sections are used.","Mobile: the hero has a primary call button, and a call/directions action bar sits right below the hero image, with the contact-strip directly after it, so phone, directions and hours are reachable in one tap.","All facts on the homepage (prices 9,80 / 8,50 / 5,20 €, 11,50 € malica, 19 € kosilo, 40 seats, 60 persons, third generation) come from the brief or the spec, and contact data is rendered by components.","The three-item product grid on desktop leaves the right third of the row empty. This is a layout property of the products component rather than something the spec can fix without inventing content, so no patch is proposed.","The photo captions visible on the dish images look like image artefacts and cannot be corrected through the spec."],"patches":[]}
